title: Neural Contextual Bandits with UCB-based Exploration
summary: This paper proposes NeuralUCB, a neural contextual bandit algorithm that uses deep neural networks with UCB-based exploration to learn unknown bounded reward functions. The algorithm achieves Õ(√T) regret under standard assumptions, representing the first neural network-based contextual bandit algorithm with near-optimal regret guarantees. The analysis leverages recent advances in neural tangent kernel theory and is validated empirically on benchmark problems.
